164189.overview:
Four Gates to Freedom consists of two parts: an action game and an adventure game. The action game has to be played first and after completing it the player is given a code that is needed to start the adventure game.

The game tells the story about a star cruiser that when exploring a far away planet is captured by a race of warrior ants. The crew and twenty scientist that were on board are drugged for future use as food for ants. The player's task is to destroy the four gates of the title and gain entry to the catacombs were the captives are held. 

The action game is a fixed screen shoot'em up where the player controls a space craft down the bottom of the screen. Above there are a red and a blue wall that protects the four gates at the top of the screen. There are four levels and in each one or several of the gates have to be destroyed but first a hole has to be blown through the walls. At the same time there are various enemies that can be shot (except one which has to be avoided). To make things harder enemies that are shot send out debris in multiple directions that can also kill the player. 

The second game is a text adventure. The player enters directions (north, south etc.) to move around while interaction with the scenes is done by entering verbs such as go, take, use etc. Clues for the adventure game are given for each level completed in the action game.

165744.overview:
Fire Galaxy is a clone of Konami's Scramble, with pieces of its follow-up Super Cobra added.

The premise is the same as in the original: Fly into a side-scrolling cavern system and shoot everything that moves, while keeping an eye on your fuel level. Drop bombs on fuel silos to avoid crashing. Early enemies are rockets launching from the ground while shooting at you, followed by enemies hovering around in the air, missiles flying fast in your direction, aliens bouncing up and down in your path, a fleet of spaceships and swarms of aliens.

Another enemy is the landscape itself. Avoid crashing into the walls of the levels during evasive maneuvers. The landscape never really narrows down like in so many other scramble clones, but instead there are formations like stalactites and stalagmites, much like in Super Cobra. The aliens regenerate unless you pound them repeatedly.

Fire Galaxy uses a character based scroller, scrolling in 8-pixel increments, with big sprites on a large screen.

166635.overview:
Your task in this arcade game is to guide a frog across a treacherous road and river, and to safety at the top of the screen. Both these sections are fraught with a variety of hazards, each of which will kill the frog and cost you a life if contact is made.

The road is full of cars and trucks, at variable speeds. The river water itself is fatal, as are the snakes which hover within on later levels. Frogger must use the arrangement of logs, turtles (which are only there for a short time) and alligators (but stay away from their faces), and then jump into one of the open home-cells, ideally one containing a fly for extra points. Once all holes have been filled, you move onto the next, harder, level.

167567.overview:
As Fast Eddie, you must go from floor to floor, collecting prizes.

Up to two prizes will be on the screen at any one time on any floor but the top one. There are a max on ten prizes per screen. On each floor, a Sneaker stands or roams back and forth. You move to another floor or jump to avoid the Sneakers. On the top floor is High-Top, the tallest Sneaker.

You have to get at least nine prizes. After you get the ninth, High-Top will be low enough to jump over. You then jump over him to get the key above him. Then it is on the the next screen.

You get ten points for the first prize, twenty for the second, and so on up to ninety points for prizes nine and ten. You don't HAVE to get the tenth prize unless you want the extra ninety points.

After every screen, you get an extra Eddie; up to a maximum of three in reserve.

167587.overview:
Game description:

Falcon Fighter is a side-scrolling action game, similar to Scramble (only you have no bullets, just bombs)

You fly through different caverns, bombing all kinds of stuff.

To not run out of ammo you have to shoot the buildings with an "A" on it and to not run out of fuel you have to shoot buildings with an "F" on it.

168222.overview:
Everyone's mothers always say "Don't make those faces! They'll stay like that!" But now you have the chance to make the silliest looking faces anyone's ever seen!

Choose from a wide assortment of eyes, ears, noses, and mouths. Then make your newly created faces blink, wiggle their ears, wink, or razz you. You can even play a "Simon Says.." type game where your face will do some kind of action and you have to follow along!

176176.overview: Froggy is inspired by the arcade game Frogger where you have to get a frog home across three separate screens in this top view game. Starting at the bottom of the first screen, you have to cross a busy road by moving your frog forwards, backwards, left or right trying to avoid traffic moving across the screen left or right, to reach the top of the screen. The next screen sees you try to cross a jungle with various creatures once again moving across the screen before trying to cross a river. You have to swim across the river from a bank but the current keeps dragging you to the right as you try to reach a lily pad. Once you make it to your home, you then repeat the game but at a higher skill level. If you touch any creature then you lose one of three lives and you are sent back to the first screen.

176186.overview: Frog Chase is a clone of Frogger. Try to get the frog in the safe spots on the other side 3 times. While trying to do that avoid trucks and don't fall in the water...your frog can not swim!

185281.overview: In Fatty Henry you play as an octopus who is about to be cooked in a London restaurant, and Dan Warren wants to eat it! Of course, the octopus doesn't want to be cooked so it tries its best to put out the fire with water drops. The octopus should be careful though, as the flames will go up and later Fatty Henry, a dog, will annoy the octopus and if he touches it the octopus will die ... just like when anything else touches it.

185282.overview:
Flight Path 737 is a flight simulator or, as the cover says, an "advanced pilot trainer". The player is the pilot of a jet airliner and his task is to take off from an airport, climb over the mountains that surround it and then land safely on an airfield in the valleys below. The player only gets one chance as there is only enough fuel for one landing.

The game is played from a first person perspective and the screen is split into two parts: a landscape view at the top and the instrument panel below. The instrument panel shows all the information that is needed such as altitude, speed and artificial horizon.

The game can be played on six different skill levels. Each level adds more complexity to the task. On the first level the mountains are 5000 ft. high and the runway is three miles long but for each level the mountains get higher and the runway gets shorter. On the most difficult level the mountains are 9200 ft. and the runway is only 1.5 miles. Each level also adds more tasks that have to be taken care. On level 2 the engine can catch fire, while level 3 requires a smoother landing. Level 4 to 6 add crosswinds and require reverse thrust when landing.

194550.overview: Frogrun! is a top view single screen game based on the arcade game Frogger where you have to get five frogs one at a time from the bottom of the screen to one of five holes at the top of the screen before a timer reaches zero for each frog. You have to cross a busy road with traffic moving across the screen left or right, and cross a river using logs, turtles and crocodiles who are also moving across the screen, before moving into a hole. You are able to move your frog left, right, forwards and backwards as you avoid the various obstacles and if you are hit by any or fall into the water then you lose one of three lives. When you reach a bank halfway there is also a snake that has to be avoided. You are able to use the back of the crocodiles but can't move on to their heads and some turtles move underwater as well.

195145.overview:
The football management game style has been one of the most enduring since Kevin Toms pioneered it in 1982. You start in the 4th division with the team of your choice, and can play on indefinitely in the hope of reaching the top division and dominating it, as well as winning the cups. Players can be bought or sold, with their transfer values varying according to the size of any bid. Their skills and morale vary as the season goes on, with resting key players in easy matches often a key move. You can take out a loan, limited depending on your division, while day-to-day bills must be covered. Matches feature short animated highlights sequences of key moments (Text only for C16).

The VIC-20 version requires a 16K memory expansion.

206888.overview: Not to be confused with Froggy from Krypton Force (which is also a Frogger clone) Froggy from Galactic Software has the same premise: Cross the frog over to the other side of the screen while avoiding cars, trucks, snakes, etc. The Galactic Software game does, however, have slightly more simplified graphics than the game from Krypton Force.

219228.overview:
Flip N Match is a 1 or 2-player tile-matching game the VIC-20.

Contains 2 difficulty levels, a standard 100-tile matching puzzle with 50 different pieces each containing a single match, or a simpler version called Flip N Match Jr., where there are a total of 25 tiles with 12 pairs and a single wild card. Game play allows for 2-player versus mode or single-player timed games where the goal is to match all tiles before a timer runs out.

418711.overview:
Fast Add is an educational math game with a twist. You only have a certain amount of time to solve each problem, hence the name. The game was developed by J.C. Bye and published in the May 1984 issue of COMPUTE!'s Gazette (which was one of the early issues that was also sold in the UK)

A version for the Commodore 64 was also published in the same issue.

419351.overview:
Originally released as The Earth Dies Screaming on Atari 8-bit by Sirius Software, Inc.. It's an action game, set in a sci-fi / futuristic, shooter, space flight and space combat themes, and was also released on VIC-20.

Two games in one: a space shoot-em-up and a pinball simulation.   It has two 4k games inside one 8k chip

Press C= key to switch between games.
The space game controls with a joystick.
The F and L keys control the pinball flippers. Press F to load a ball into the ramp, L to adjust, both F and L together to start.

419353.overview:
The Fourth Encounter is a fixed screen shoot 'em up for one or two players. 
As the title might indicate it consists of four stages with different enemies in each. They can be played through in one go, or the player can pick any of them without completing the previous ones. 
The enemies in each stage has their own tactics in taking out the player. In the first wave the enemies try to crash into the player, while the aliens of the second and third stage fires at the player.  The player ship can only move along the bottom and shot up against the enemies. The fourth stage is the one that differs the most from the other stages. Here the enemies follow the edges of the screen and shoot in towards the player who now can move around the screen freely. What's more, it's also possible to shoot in two directions, both up and down. The player has five lives and it's game over when they are all lost. Three different skill levels can be chosen from.

Source: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eKHhZPSNYwY

423364.overview:
Frogger is a variant of the arcade game of the same name. The basic premise is to guide frogs to safety by climbing a 3rd person viewed screen within a time limit, first by crossing a busy road avoiding contact with traffic, then by crossing a river without making contact with the water, then by safely reaching one of the homecells at the top of the screen. Alternating lanes of traffic move in opposite directions and at varying speeds, and the river flow sees alternate 'lanes' of logs and crocodiles (avoid the heads!) moving in opposite directions. Another additional challenge is that each homecell can only be used once - emptying an occupied one costs you a life - once all have been filled a bonus is awarded and all are cleared,

In this variant there is also a short maze to clear between the road and river, hitting any of the edges of these also kills your frog. There are stationary lanes of traffic at each end

423468.overview:
Frog is a 1-player Frogger clone for the VIC-20.

The player attempts to navigate a frog across a busy highway and a river while avoiding being hit by cars or falling into the water. The player starts with 3 lives, and moves in the cardinal directions. Cars and logs move horizontally across the screen, and turtles only stay on the surface a short period of time. If all 6 zones at the top of the screen are filled, the player advances to a more difficult level.

448470.overview:
Feeding Time is a 1-player arcade game for the VIC-20.

The player controls a hunter named in the forest armed with a gun trying to protect himself from attacking wild animals. The animals approach from the cardinal directions, and the player can only turn and fire in these directions. Each hit kills an animal, but a new one takes its place, approaching from the edge of the screen. Every 20 animals shot leads to a new level where the animals approach faster. The player starts with 3 lives, and a life is lost if an animal reaches the hunter.

455862.overview:
The Guardian of Forbidden Tower has turned you, Prince Harry, into a mutant, and imprisoned you in the chambers of his tower. Overcome the automatic defence system and collect all the jewels scattered around the tower to be restored to your former self and gain your freedom.

The player controls a small character who can move left, right, and jump, and moves through a number of different rooms. The player has 5 lives, and must avoid a number of dangers including spikes, monsters, and moving platforms.

455976.overview:
You are a spider whose aim is to eat flies in a maze of bushes, but stopping you from doing this is a creature known as the Weasel, who will follow you around, even going so far as passing through the bushes. Once you eat all the flies on screen, you must enter one of the bushes to complete the level and move onto the next one where there will be more flies to eat. Although you deal with only one Weasel in the game, the further you progress the faster it moves. If the Weasel makes contact with you, the game will end.

The game was developed and released by PR Software in 1982, and rereleased by Abrasco Ltd., later that same year.

456358.overview: The player can review or create their own music selection by setting tempo, value, and notes on a music graph. After they've created their musical composition, they can enter a game where they move a conductor vertically, as they try to follow the horizontally scrolling notes on the screen. If they miss too many notes, or are caught by a chasing dog, they lose a life.

456402.overview: Flight Zero-One Five is a flight simulator where you don't have a view outside the cockpit, just your instrument panel on the screen. The aim is to take-off, fly the plane in the air before descending and landing. Your instrument panel is quite basic and you have at your disposal Airspeed, Range, Height, Gear, Time, Course Indicator, Fuel, Brakes and Revs. An Artificial Horizon can be used to keep the plane level and there is also a radar screen showing the position of the plane and the runway. Before you start to fly, you can select the landing difficulty (1-5) with one being average and five being advanced.

476836.overview: Frantic is a 1st person shooter where you are being pulled by gravity downwards on a moon of the planet Spectrum. You have an anti-grav pack that allows you to stop mid-air, move left or right but you are unable to move upwards. As you fall there are many aliens moving around the area and you must blast them with your laser while avoiding getting shot by them. On the left and bottom of the screen are two radars which show the position of the aliens either above or below, and left or right of your position. Using your anti-grav pack and laser uses fuel which is shown by a gauge which decreases and when you run out of fuel then it is game over.
